issues.quote: his father's silver watch had run badly for ten years and that he would not let anyone touch it, not even his uncle
issues.fact: O1 says only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine. It does not say which watch that was or whether it was reliable.
issues.misreading: The sentence can be read as Félix's own watch being the silver watch that has run badly for ten years, which would make the twenty-to-nine reading suspect. It can also be read as a different watch from the one shown at the table, which leaves unclear which watch was read. Either reading casts doubt on whether the 8:40 reading belongs to Félix's watch, though the sheet states it does.
